svg.title: Editing and steering
svg.desc: Where can a person intervene in the work? Editing an object, configuring behaviour, steering the current process and controlling commitment operate at different points. Source illustration: Viewers switch between sound sources, imitations and sensory descriptions for the same captioned material.

text.tspan: Where can a person intervene in the work?

process through edits, settings, parameters and reversible actions.
